notes.title: Wishlist Season 3 today
notes.notes:
Today, the store pages for Being a DIK - Season 3 and Being a DIK: Season 3 - The complete official guide are live. You can now add the DLCs to your wishlist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36058373/cc7f0e515ba3b54f9907f58941d44a30626f59fc.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807120/Being_a_DIK__Season_3/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220920/Being_a_DIK_Season_3__The_complete_official_guide/

While the store pages are a clear milestone in this project, you're probably wondering about the development progress.

It's been a long year for me, and I've worked diligently on Episode 11, which is now in the late stages of its development cycle.

The episodes continue to grow in size throughout this passion-filled project and I'm close to the point where one single episode is almost the size of the entirety of Season 1.
As you know from last year's news, Season 3 will be even bigger than Season 2 - and considerably so.

With Episode 11, animations are now 60 fps as a standard and I have continued to push the image quality up.
I'm doing my utmost to bring you the continuation that you deserve and progress is being made 24/7.

After I conclude the development of Episode 11, only one more episode remains to be developed before I can bring Season 3 to you on Steam.

Happy Holidays and have a wonderful end to your year!
Thanks for your patience and support.

Now, what are you waiting for? Go check out the new store pages.

Love
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Season 3 news
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36058373/1f094db002c27b31442aaa8aa56f84c4564d4c38.jpg[/img]
Today, I can announce that the Episode 10 development is complete and the episode is being beta tested.

With the completion of Episode 10, Season 3 now stands at ~60% total completion.

Currently, Season 3 consists of Episode Interlude, Episodes 9 and 10.
Episodes 11 & 12 remain to be developed before Season 3 is complete.

Season 3 is roughly 12 GB today, including 12,000 images, 700 animated scenes, and 80 new songs.
Season 3 is already comparable to Season 2 in size and content, even when two episodes remain to be developed.

Among the improvements you'll discover in Season 3, you'll find an overall higher image and animation quality. I've also developed new exciting mini-games for this season.

Thanks for your support and patience while I'm putting all my efforts into developing the best game I can create.

Love
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Changelog
notes.notes:
This upgrade includes major changes, as the game is upgraded to 64-bit now.
Overall performance should increase, and you should encounter fewer, if any, crashes from memory errors.
Please note, there might be some issues with loading some of your save files with this patch, but hopefully, everything will work without any issues.
If you encounter an error when loading a save, try clicking ignore or rollback a few times.

[list]
[*] Upgraded Ren'Py version to 7.4.10
[*] Prepared Season 1 for the upcoming DLC
[*] Fixed deprecated functionality and fixed bugs due to the Ren'Py upgrade.
[*] Updated functionality for viewing special renders in the Rewards app.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Rewards app, showing an exclamation mark wrongly when reloading saves after finding special renders.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the app description would still show after closing the phone.
[*] Fixed a bug with the new message icon in episode 2.
[*] Fixed a dialogue issue for Isabella's morning scene in episode 2.
[*] Fixed a dialogue bug with gender classes episodes 1-2.
[*] Redesigned the game menus
[*] Added a button to manually save persistent data in the Save menu; automatic saving still works as before.
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the vault unlocked vaults from other episodes.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could buy mini-game-related cheats from Derek when not playing mini-games in episode 1.
[*] Fixed a rare bug with Brawler that caused four options that resulted in a miss to show at once.
[*] Fixed a bug with the math tests that displayed the wrong grade when cheating.
[*] Corrected typos
[*] Updated the format of the guide. It should be easier to read than before.
[*] Added a Guide button to the quick menu of the game. You can access the guide using this button or the 'g' key as usual.
[/list]

notes.title: Season 2 is 75% finished!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36058373/a47c98060ec390132c8d7dfad0db8162107eba7c.jpg[/img]
The development of the second season of Being a DIK just hit 75% completion.

The second season will be bigger than Season 1 and include four brand new episodes.
So far, with one episode left to develop before I can release it on Steam, 566 animated scenes and over 9700 images have been produced for the second season.
This means that Season 2 is already bigger than Season 1, so you can expect plenty of content.

Before release, there will be a store page for the DLC where you can wishlist the game.

I don't have any ETA when the Steam release is.
The timeframe depends on how the development of the final episode of the season fares.

I have uploaded a patch for Being a DIK - Season 1 to Steam.
Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] During free roam events, any progress made in phone apps will be saved when saving the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a conflict between entering save names, pet names and other inputs.
[*] Any illegal characters typed for your save name will be removed immediately to avoid getting a blank save name.
[*] Lowered the volume of the intro splash screen and made its sound level controlled by the SFX channel.
[*] Set the power save option to be disabled by default to favor performance over energy settings.
[*] Updated the money system backend.
[*] Replaced the animations for the main girl episode report and updated the design.
[*] Added a presplash loading image.
[*] Added a skip 5 pages at the time button for the Save/Load screen.
[*] Disabled right-clicking the Skip button to skip to the next choice.
[*] The middle-mouse button now brings up the in-game phone and can be used to close any children menu of the phone.
[*] The quick menu will be hidden when using the phone and restored when closing the phone.
[*] The save/load menu will be hidden when using the phone and restored when closing the phone.
[*] Fixed an issue with autosaving, causing a lag spike during choices during animations.
[*] To reduce lag, autosaving is now less frequent. There's an option in the Preferences menu to remove Autosaving and thus remove lag spikes.
[*] Fixed a rare bug with Shuffle.
[*] Fixed a bug in episode 3 where Quinn's text message would cause an error if you entered and exited Jill's chat first.
[*] Corrected typos in episodes 1-4
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

Yours,
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Being a DIK - Season 1: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Today a patch launched for Being a DIK - Season 1.
I don't want to update the game too often since there's a risk that some old saves become incompatible with every patch.
That's sadly how the RenPy engine works with save files. I hope that too many aren't affected by this and if you experience any issue loading an old save, try clicking Ignore or Rollback a few times and see if it pops back into gear.

This patch brings fixes and improvements to the game. The most noteworthy fix is that the Gallery counter, which in some cases made players miss the gallery achievement, has been fixed.

Let me know in the discussion forum if you need any assistance.

On a further note, the development of Season 2 is approximately [b]25% completed[/b].
A huge thanks for your support!

Best regards
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Patch notes, February 16, 2020
notes.notes:
Thank you all for reporting bugs to me. I'm monitoring the threads and trying to fix everything that gets reported. This is a list of bugs that I have fixed since release.
Restart Steam and you should get an update with the latest changes.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in episode 1 where the chat with Josy wouldn't trigger a dialogue prompt during the date in certain cases.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty setting for Brawler. It should feel easier to play Brawler on Easy/Normal. Hard difficulty setting will feel slightly easier.
[*] Two animations were added to a lewd scene (episode 4).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cheating to fail on the English test in episode 4.
[*] Fixed a cosmetic bug with Brawler with text messages after winning a fight multiple times and getting no reward.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at the Save/Load screen if special characters were used to comment the save.
[*] Corrected typos
[/list]

If you encounter any issues with the game, please try verifying your game cache as the first step. Sometimes your download is corrupt and may be missing files.

Use the following steps to see if your game files are valid or not:
Right-click the game in the library and select properties.
Click Local files > Verify integrity of game cache
Wait until the process is complete and Steam will download any missing files.

Thank you all for your support! And please, continue to report any bugs you find and I will try my utmost to assist you.

Best regards
Dr PinkCake
